```{r Primary myotube cells}

raw <- read.delim(here::here("data-raw/PrimaryMyotubes_Proteome_Report.tsv"), header = TRUE, na.strings = c("NaN"))
# 7922 x 11 (7 samples)

# load metadata
#meta_scr <- xx


# name rows by unique gene name
raw$PG.Genes %>% duplicated() %>% any()
# TRUE
raw %>% group_by(PG.Genes) %>% summarize(frequency = n()) %>%
    arrange(desc(frequency)) %>% filter(frequency > 1)
raw_unique <- make_unique(raw, "PG.Genes", "PG.UniProtIds", delim = ";")
raw_unique$name %>% duplicated() %>% any()
# FALSE
rownames(raw_unique) <- raw_unique$name


# convert NA's and log2 transform the sample columns
log2 <- raw_unique
log2[, 5:11] <- apply(raw_unique[, 5:11], 2, function(x) {
    x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    ifelse(!is.na(x) & x > 0, log2(x), NA)})



# rename samples (columns)
log2_renamed <- log2
colnames(log2_renamed)[5:11] <- KI$combined

################################# FIGURE S5K #######################################

## dynamic range
median_intensities <- apply(raw_unique[, 5:11], 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
rank_abundance <- rank(-median_intensities)
median_intensities_log10 <- log10(median_intensities)
dynamic_range <- data.frame(genes = rownames(raw_unique), RankAbundance = rank_abundance, Log10MedianIntensity = median_intensities_log10)

dynamic_range <- dynamic_range %>%
    mutate(PointColor = "darkblue")

label_low <- c("PRKAA1", "PRKAA2", "PRKAB1", "PRKAB2", "PRKAG1", "PRKAG2", "PRKAG3")
label_low_data <- list()
for (gene in label_low) {
    gene_subset <- dynamic_range[dynamic_range$genes == gene, ]
    label_low_data[[gene]] <- gene_subset
}
labels_low <- do.call(rbind, label_low_data)

dyn <- ggplot(dynamic_range, aes(x = RankAbundance, y = Log10MedianIntensity)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = PointColor), alpha = 0.3, shape = 21) +
    labs(x = "Protein Rank Abundance", y = "Log10 Median Intensity") +
    theme_classic() +
    guides(color = guide_legend(na.rm = TRUE)) +
    geom_text_repel(
        data = labels_low,
        aes(label = genes, color = PointColor),  
        size= 1.5,
        nudge_y = -0.5,  
        nudge_x = -1300,
        force = 30,  
        box.padding = 0.1, 
        point.padding = 0,  
        max.overlaps = Inf,
        segment.size = 0.3,
        segment.alpha = 0.7,
        min.segment.length = unit(0, "lines")
    ) +
    scale_color_identity() + 
    theme(
        text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "black", size = 6),
        legend.position = "none"
    )

dyn


```
